title: Design System: 吉時行樂 Lucky Hour

display.purpose: The red date numeral on the day sheet; clamp(56px, 16vw, 72px) under 480px.

seal.purpose: Verdict characters inside the seal stamp.

value.purpose: The answer in every ruled row, 宜/忌 item and hour.

body.purpose: Reading prose and default UI text; tabular figures.

label-vertical.purpose: Vermilion heading set vertically in the 28px rail.

label-row.purpose: Vermilion centred label in the 58px row-label column.

glyph.purpose: Noto Sans Symbols (Google Fonts, 400 and 600) for zodiac signs ♈–♓ and planet symbols ☉☽☿♀♂♃♄♅♆♇ in the 十二星座 and 西洋星盤 tabs; cssVar --zd-glyph / --astro-glyph. Sizes run 17–21px inline, clamp(54px, 15vw, 72px) on the sign sheet, and 150px as a watermark in the reading slip's empty bottom field. Content, never UI icons.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Every framed almanac sheet: paper lifting off paper.

shadows.name: double-frame
shadows.value: border: 2px solid var(--red); outline: 1px solid var(--red); outline-offset: 2px
shadows.purpose: The thick-and-thin almanac frame (not a shadow; recorded here as the system's depth device).

motion.name: ease-sheet
motion.purpose: Sheets and tab bodies sliding in with slight weighted overshoot.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animations collapse to cf-fade, 160ms max; transitions 120ms

breakpoints.name: xs
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: narrow day header, lucky strip stacks.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: tightened day sheet so the first viewport holds date, 宜/忌 and current hour.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: modals become bottom sheets; control strips wrap.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: min-width: sheet column plus sticky side column.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid black action such as 複製分享.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--hair-strong, rgba(26,26,26,0.26)); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--paper-hi, #fbf7ec); color: var(--ink, #1a1a1a); font: 500 14px/1.2 "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #b8231f); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink, #1a1a1a); border-color: var(--ink, #1a1a1a); color: var(--on-ink, #f4eedf); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink-2, #3d3830); border-color: var(--ink-2, #3d3830); }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Paper button with an ink hairline for ordinary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--hair-strong, rgba(26,26,26,0.26)); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--paper-hi, #fbf7ec); color: var(--ink, #1a1a1a); font: 500 14px/1.2 "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 120ms; } .ds-btn-default:hover { background: var(--paper-2, #ece4d0); border-color: var(--ink-2, #3d3830); } .ds-btn-default:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #b8231f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Vermilion-wash action; also the toggled/active state.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, rgba(184,35,31,0.6)); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--red-wash, rgba(184,35,31,0.08)); color: var(--red, #b8231f); font: 500 14px/1.2 "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--red-wash-2, rgba(184,35,31,0.14)); border-color: var(--red, #b8231f); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #b8231f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Paper field with ink hairline; vermilion on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--hair-strong, rgba(26,26,26,0.26)); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--paper-hi, #fbf7ec); color: var(--ink, #1a1a1a); font: 400 15px/1.4 "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--gray, #6e6a60); } .ds-input:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--red-wash-2, rgba(184,35,31,0.14)); outline-offset: 0; border-color: var(--red, #b8231f); }

components.name: Tab Row
components.description: Scrolling system tabs; active is bold ink with a vermilion underline.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab is-active">老黃曆</button><button class="ds-tab">星座</button><button class="ds-tab">紫微</button><button class="ds-tab">星盤</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hair, rgba(26,26,26,0.14)); background: var(--paper, #f4eedf); } .ds-tab { position: relative; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--gray, #6e6a60); font: 500 15px/1 "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tab::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; background: var(--red, #b8231f); transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #1a1a1a); } .ds-tab.is-active { color: var(--ink, #1a1a1a); font-weight: 700; } .ds-tab.is-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #b8231f); outline-offset: -4px; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small printed tag; brand variant in vermilion wash.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--hair-strong, rgba(26,26,26,0.26)); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--ink-2, #3d3830); font: 500 12px/1.5 "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-badge-brand { border-color: var(--rule-strong, rgba(184,35,31,0.6)); background: var(--red-wash, rgba(184,35,31,0.08)); color: var(--red, #b8231f); }

components.css: .ds-sheet { margin: 3px; background: var(--paper-hi, #fbf7ec); color: var(--ink, #1a1a1a); border: 2px solid var(--red, #b8231f); outline: 1px solid var(--red, #b8231f); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.16); } .ds-ruled { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0,1fr); } .ds-vh { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--red, #b8231f); color: var(--red, #b8231f); } .ds-vh span { writing-mode: vertical-rl; font: 700 13px/1 "Noto Serif TC", serif; letter-spacing: 0.2em; } .ds-rows { margin: 0; } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 58px minmax(0,1fr); min-height: 44px; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(184,35,31,0.32)); } .ds-row dt { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(184,35,31,0.32)); color: var(--red, #b8231f); font: 600 13px/1.2 "Noto Serif TC", serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; } .ds-row dd { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; align-content: center; column-gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-row dd b { font: 600 15px/22px "Noto Serif TC", serif; } .ds-row dd small { color: var(--gray, #6e6a60); font: 400 12px/18px "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; }

components.name: Seal Stamp
components.description: Rotated vermilion verdict seal; ink variant for unfavourable verdicts.
components.css: .ds-seal { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 80px; height: 80px; margin: 12px; background: var(--red, #b8231f); color: var(--on-red, #f8f1e2); font: 900 30px/1 "Noto Serif TC", serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-indent: 0.08em; border-radius: 7px 5px 8px 6px; transform: rotate(-4deg); outline: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--on-red, #f8f1e2) 75%, transparent); outline-offset: -5px; animation: ds-stamp 620ms cubic-bezier(0.2,1.6,0.4,1) both; } .ds-seal-ink { background: var(--ink, #1a1a1a); color: var(--on-ink, #f4eedf); } @keyframes ds-stamp { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(-12deg) scale(1.55); } 55% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: rotate(-4deg) scale(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-seal { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Every screen is a page of a red-and-black Taiwanese farmer's almanac (紅黑雙色農民曆). Thin cream almanac paper carries exactly two printing inks: vermilion and black, with a warm gray reserved for notes. Each fortune system sets its result as a ruled almanac sheet: a thick-and-thin double vermilion frame, hairline vermilion rules between rows, and a vertical vermilion heading column reading top to bottom. Six tools read as one book because they share one sheet grammar.

The verdict is a rotated vermilion seal stamp, pressed onto the sheet. Good fortune prints red, bad fortune prints ink: 吉 is vermilion, 凶 is black, and the same red/ink split carries through 宜/忌, good and bad hours, 正位/逆位, and star brightness. The dark theme is not a new palette; it reprints the same two inks on ink-black paper, lifting vermilion so it holds contrast.

Density is that of a printed almanac: tight ruled rows, tabular figures, serif values, small gray notes. It refuses the category's starry purple mystic gradients, glassy blurred panels and the generic soft card stack. Depth comes from print (frames and rules), not from floating surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks on paper: vermilion and black, warm gray for notes only.
Double vermilion frame (2px border plus 1px outline at 2px offset) around every result sheet.
Vertical vermilion heading columns (`writing-mode: vertical-rl`) in a 28px rail.
Rotated vermilion seal stamps for verdicts, with an inset hairline rim.
Ming serif for headings, dates and values; sans for controls and notes.
Signature motion: seals stamp down and settle; sheets slide in with slight weighted overshoot.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: Every mark on a sheet is vermilion, black or note gray. A new hue enters only as data the user asked for (a lucky colour swatch, tarot or oracle artwork), never as interface colour.

rules.name: The 吉 Red, 凶 Ink Rule
rules.body: Auspicious marks print vermilion; inauspicious marks print black. Never colour 凶 red or use green/amber for good/bad.

rules.name: The Reprint Rule
rules.body: Dark theme swaps the paper to ink-black and lifts both inks; it never introduces glow, gradients or new accents.

rules.name: The Printed vs. Operated Rule
rules.body: If it would appear in a paper almanac, set it in the serif; if it is an app control or a gloss, set it in the sans.

rules.name: The Glyph Is Content Rule
rules.body: Noto Sans Symbols sets astrological symbols as data, inked in vermilion or black like any other value. It is never a UI icon set.

rules.name: The Vertical Heading Rule
rules.body: Section headings on a sheet run vertically in the 28px vermilion rail, not as a horizontal label above the content.

rules.name: The Frame Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate content with a vermilion rule or frame first; reach for a shadow only for a layer that sits above the page. No blur, no glass, no offset block shadows.

dos: Do set every system's result on an almanac sheet with the double vermilion frame and ruled rows.
Do head sheet sections with the vertical vermilion heading column in a 28px rail.
Do print 吉, 宜, good hours and favourable marks in vermilion and 凶, 忌 and unfavourable marks in ink.
Do use the rotated vermilion seal (or its ink variant) for a reading's verdict, stamped in with the stamp curve.
Do set dates, values and headings in Noto Serif TC and controls and notes in Noto Sans TC, with tabular figures.
Do keep tap targets at 44px on coarse pointers and fields at 16px text on touch.
Do fall back to fades under reduced motion.
donts: Don't introduce purple, starry or mystic gradients, glow, or glassy blurred panels.
Don't add interface hues beyond vermilion, black, note gray and the ochre warning.
Don't colour good/bad outcomes green/amber/red; the only split is red and ink.
Don't stack soft rounded cards; radius stays at 4px or less outside the seal.
Don't put small tracked labels above headings; sheet headings run in the vertical rail.
Don't separate content with shadows where a vermilion rule will do.
